text: Restored ScriptSource as an enum with the supported case Inline private[ScriptSource](...) constructor, preserving ordinal and the public enum ABI. The checked and unsafe factories now return ScriptSource.Inline precisely. Replaced the hand-written sum decoder with Circe's derived decoder plus a validating Inline leaf decoder, restoring additive unknown-field compatibility while preserving the construction-time byte bound. Added exact historical wire fixtures for Inline, StagedLocal and ExistingRemote; added unknown sibling-field coverage for all three; and pinned enum ordinals and precise factory return types. Full suite passes on both configured lanes: 516 tests on Scala 3.3.8 and 516 on Scala 3.8.4.
